blocks.text: Carbonyl group aldehydes aur ketones ki kimiya par hukmrani karta hai. In ke do bunyadi qism ke reactions hain: C=O group par nucleophilic addition reactions, aur alpha carbon (carbonyl group ke saath wala carbon) ke khaas reactions, jaise CH3CO- compounds ka iodoform reaction.

blocks.prompt: Carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi reactions ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: C=O group par nucleophilic addition, aur alpha carbon par reactions.

items: Carbonyl compounds: nucleophilic addition aur alpha-carbon reactions.
